items.html: *We shall now explain the matter of these Mochin: what their meaning is, and how many phases there are in them. And behold, in this discourse I heard in it various discourses, and at first glance they seem to argue and contradict one another, and therefore I must set you aright in them, in extreme brevity. And the matter is, that once I heard from my teacher, may his memory be blessed, that the Mochin of Katnut, even those of the nursing, descend below, to the world of Beria, at the time when the Mochin of Gadlut, of the second pregnancy, enter and come. And another time I heard that they become membranes to the Mochin of Gadlut. And another time I heard that these three kinds of Mochin, that are in the three times of pregnancy, nursing, and Mochin, are the Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshama of ZA, for the vessels within it.
